category_title: Struggling readers who forget intended dictation during technology delays
scenario_title: Dictating a patterned story using Speech Recognition
minimal_context: David is at the writing center using the Dragon Speech Recognition app on an iPad to dictate his own version of a patterned story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's write your version of the Brown Bear story on the iPad. Press the button to dictate your sentence about the Transformer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Touches the dictation button and goes blank) I want to write... um...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should say?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I see a Transformer driving by me. (Looks at the screen) The app timed out.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try pressing the button and saying it again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Repeats the process three times) It typed the wrong words again! (Deletes the entire sentence) I don't want to do this anymore.
